items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: We had a fellow on piano by the name of Burroughs Lovingood. Yeah. Burroughs Lovingood. We sent and got Lovingood from there.

ctx.x: We had a fellow on piano by the name of Burroughs Lovingood. Yeah. Burroughs Lovingood. We sent and got Lovingood from there. Well, I can tell you about that a little later on. So, I played there for awhile. It's a funny thing, though, while I was there, while I was studying, when I was at the Chauffeur's Club. Boy, they had some beautiful waitresses -- very beautiful girls, and they couldn't understand why all the boys would be up there buying those club sandwiches and setting the waitresses up and why is it…

What's the matter that you all hate the trumpet player? Why does he -- why is it that he didn't come up here? They say, "Well, he's sitting back out there building air castles." That's what they were saying. I was studying at this time. This was before Hudson had told me that -- I had -- he had given me all he could -- had exhausted his vocabulary or what have you. So, I played fair and went on and on until a fellow by the name of Chauffeur Inge came to Chauffeur's Club and I wondered why he kept a hanging around…
